atoms.a: My cold is worse in the morning.

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Lückentext mit den richtigen Adjektiven.

atoms.b: Every time I pack my suitcase for a holiday, I feel ((++excited self-conscious)). Sometimes I get ((++frustrated relaxed)) because I don't know what to pack. In the past, my mother used to help me, but sometimes we were so ((++annoyed amazed)) by each other that we stopped packing together. Although it's not much fun, I am ((++proud isolated)) after having packed everything all by myself.

Recently, I watched a ((++tense romantic)) film about criminals in New York. The fact that the story is based on real events made it even more ((++exciting funny)). There was a ((++surprising silly)) plot twist, which I didn't see coming. In the film there were lots of car races, so it was ((++action-packed depressing)). It also had ((++comical sad)) elements, when the characters made jokes of their situation. I love ((++entertaining corny)) films!

atoms.a: The book I read was romantic,
atoms.b: but sometimes I found it too corny.
